name: Hanaoka Suzune
source:
"Hanaoka Suzune. Top of the class, and an elegant beauty for sure, she's got this refined air around her... Almost ethereal."

The protagonist's classmate. Consistently gets perfect scores on every test. She spends most of her time studying in the library.
